🎥🩸: Simon Says (2026)

A birthday celebration meant to be a night of unforgettable memories becomes a terrifying battle for survival when a mysterious entertainer introduces a deadly version of “Simon Says.” What seems like harmless fun quickly turns sinister as every command comes with a horrifying price.

Trapped with nowhere to run, the guests are forced to follow increasingly dangerous instructions while secrets, fear, and betrayal begin tearing them apart. As the game continues, they must uncover the truth behind their captor’s twisted plan before they become the next victims.

With a blend of dark comedy, brutal surprises, and relentless suspense, Simon Says turns a childhood classic into a nightmare of survival where one wrong move can change everything.

Simon Says is out now on Tubi.
